## bdba622b3265

**Classification: reproduced lesson ambiguity — spatial ordering can replace
color ordering for all demonstrations but not the query.**

I audited selected generator SHA-256
`8f66b2168fefc102af00c247620518eaf55e3d1a1275d3f03c0251627250f5cd`
(version 1.2.2) without modifying it.  The intended Racket rule sorts blobs by
`(color, r1, c1)` and forms the pairwise area-comparison matrix.  A plausible
rival sorts the same blobs by top-left spatial position `(r1, c1, color)` and
then performs the identical comparisons.

At seed `2`, difficulty `easy`, sample indices `160`, `161`, and `162`, the
spatial rival exactly matches each selected-authority label.  At query index
`163`, it differs.  All four grids are ordinary default draws and pass the
target's `self_check`.  Racket execution was source-bound and matched an
independent Python mirror of the intended rule.

Evidence and replay:

- `checks/audit/bdba622b3265/finding.json`
- `checks/audit/bdba622b3265/reproduce.py`
- command from packet root:
  `python3 review.py run python3 ../checks/audit/bdba622b3265/reproduce.py`

The finding is finite: it demonstrates one ambiguous three-demo lesson, not that
all lessons are ambiguous.  The target also fails current lint/override checks
(`checks/audit/bdba622b3265/lint/` and `override/`), but the lesson ambiguity is
the primary audit result.  No source fix was made.
